name: DFW Cubing Fall 2022
information: This competition is supported by [CubingUSA](https://cubingusa.org/). Note: This competition is on a Sunday. Competitions tend to fill quickly, so we strongly recommend competitors register immediately right when registration opens to secure a spot. # ***NO OUTSIDE FOOD OR DRINK IS PERMITTED IN THE VENUE.*** - Please review the [competitor information](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/DFWCubingFall2022#20839-competitor-information) tab before the competition. - Please review the other tabs for more information on the competition. Please note that the [schedule](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/DFWCubingFall2022#competition-schedule) is subject to change, as we may hold events slightly earlier or later than shown depending on whether the competition is running ahead of schedule or behind schedule.
